subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear customer, Thank you for booking your flight with our airline. We are pleased to confirm your reservation for the following itinerary: Flight: ABC123 Date: January 15, 2023 Departure: City A Arrival: City B Please find attached your e-ticket for your reference. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels!
